ValidationRule.description: Primary Unit of Interest must be populated once the opportunity enters Negotiation or any downstream stage.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'EOI'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Token Paid'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed Won (Booked)') ), ISBLANK(Primary_Unit__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Primary Unit of Interest is required before entering Negotiation.
